messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "medicines causing drowsiness or slow breathing"
set: ["medicines causing drowsiness or slow breathing", "drugs that cause drowsiness or slow breathing", "slow breathing", "avoid other drugs that cause drowsiness or slow breathing", "slow or stopped breathing", "slow or stop breathing", "taking other medicines that can slow breathing", "slow breathing with long pauses", "alcohol or other medicines that cause drowsiness", "other medicines that cause drowsiness", "medicines that slow the heart", "drugs that make you sleepy or slow your breathing", "illness causing vomiting or diarrhea", "other seizure medicines that cause drowsiness", "drowsiness", "slow or irregular heartbeat"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "drugs that cause drowsiness or slow breathing",
    "avoid other drugs that cause drowsiness or slow breathing",
    "other medicines that cause drowsiness",
    "drugs that make you sleepy or slow your breathing",
    "other seizure medicines that cause drowsiness",
    "alcohol or other medicines that cause drowsiness"
  ],
  "alias": "drugs that cause drowsiness or slow breathing"
}
